questions.q: What does 'Ich bekomme ein Geschenk' mean?
questions.explain: False friend: 'bekommen' means 'to get/receive', not 'to become'. 'To become' is 'werden'.

options: A wine festival on the Rhine
A famous beer and folk festival in Munich
questions.explain: 'Das Oktoberfest' is the famous beer and funfair festival held in Munich.
'Das Feuerwerk' means 'the fireworks (display)'.

options: To store food in a larder
questions.explain: 'Speichern' means 'to save' a file or data on a computer.
'Der Zuschauer' means 'the spectator/viewer' (someone watching).
'Schenken' means 'to give (as a gift)', so 'Geschenke schenken' = 'to give presents'.
'Die Gesundheit' means 'health'; from 'gesund' = healthy.
'Eine Sendung' is a TV/radio programme (from 'senden', to broadcast).
'Der Faschingsdienstag' is Shrove Tuesday, the peak day of carnival before Lent.
'Gesund' means 'healthy'; the opposite is 'ungesund' (unhealthy).
'Großzügig' means 'generous'; it does not literally mean 'big' despite containing 'groß'.

questions.q: What does 'der Nikolaustag' involve in the German-speaking world?
options: Children get sweets in their boots on 6 December
questions.explain: On St Nicholas' Day (6 December) children traditionally find sweets in their cleaned boots/shoes.
'Berühmt' means 'famous', e.g. 'Er ist berühmt für seine Musik' = 'He is famous for his music'.
'Die Beziehung' means 'the relationship'.

questions.q: How do you say 'We celebrate Easter with the family'?
options: Wir feiern Ostern mit der Familie
Wir feiern Weihnachten mit der Familie
Wir feiern Ostern ohne die Familie
questions.explain: 'Feiern' = 'to celebrate', 'Ostern' = 'Easter', 'mit der Familie' = 'with the family'.
'Die Glatze' means 'a bald head'; 'eine Glatze haben' = 'to be bald'.
'Witzig' means 'funny/witty' (from 'der Witz' = joke).

questions.q: How do you say 'I have brown hair and blue eyes'?
options: Ich bin braune Haare und blaue Augen
Ich habe blaue Haare und braune Augen
Ich habe braune Haare und blaue Augen
Ich habe braun Haare und blau Augen
questions.explain: Use 'haben' for features and add the plural adjective ending -e: 'braune Haare', 'blaue Augen'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I get on my parents' nerves'?
options: Ich gehe meinen Eltern auf die Nerven
Ich gehe mit meinen Eltern aus
Meine Eltern sind nett zu mir
questions.explain: 'Jemandem auf die Nerven gehen' = 'to get on someone's nerves'.
'Der Datenschutz' means 'data protection/privacy'.
